153rd_ny_role.source: NY State Military Museum 153rd historical sketch (Phisterer)
153rd_ny_role.verbatim: at Cedar Creek the 153rd lost '81 killed, wounded and missing'
153rd_ny_role.hubbell_note: James Hubbell (Co. I) wounded here ('night blindness'/flesh wound, per family + brother Charles's letter). Co. I also: Sgt. James Lucas killed; 1st Sgt. Samuel Peltier wounded; Lt. Col. Alexander Strain wounded. The single deadliest day for the Hubbell brothers' 153rd circle.
